title: Automation execution metrics
description: platform/tasks/<task-name>/automation-execution/execution-metrics.json, written by the automation-execution skill. One entry per command run of one binding, extracted from the runner's machine-readable outputs. Values are never estimated: unknown values are null. Case-specific observed values (e.g. counts read during the run) may be added as extra properties.

generated_from.description: Which outputs the values were extracted from.

framework.description: Project dir of the binding, e.g. playwright-ts, shaft-java.

test_status.description: Status of the test itself as the runner recorded it. A run whose test passed but whose command failed keeps 'passed' here and sets build = FAILURE.

wall_clock_ms.description: Shell time around the whole command; null when not measured.

build.description: Build-tool result, for bindings that use one (Maven).
